slides.say: Suspense lets you show a fallback, like a spinner, until the code and data of its children are ready.
While Albums suspends, React shows the closest Suspense boundary’s fallback. When the data is ready, it swaps in Albums.

slides.text: What suspends: lazy code, use(promise), Suspense-enabled frameworks, stylesheets with precedence.
slides.say: What makes a boundary wait? Lazy loaded code, reading a promise with use, data from a Suspense enabled framework, and some stylesheets.

slides.text: Not detected: fetching inside an Effect or event handler.
slides.say: Suspense does not detect data fetched inside an Effect or an event handler.
